relationships.subject: SARS-CoV-2
relationships.evidence_quote: In COVID-19, the coronavirus activates macrophages by inducing the generation of pro-inflammatory cytokines [interleukin (IL)-1, IL-6, IL-18 and TNF]

relationships.subject: caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: results in the release of pro-IL-1β that is cleaved by caspase-1, followed by the production of active mature IL-1β

relationships.subject: monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: They bind specifically to the antigenic determinant of the spike protein, inhibiting the pathogenicity of the virus.

key_findings: Review: SARS-CoV-2 drives macrophage cytokine release and caspase-1-dependent IL-1β maturation (cytokine storm); spike-targeting mABs are promising but have side effects and need further study.
